items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: INTERVIEWER: And Willie Jackson. Willie Jackson. Nookie Johnson and Willie Jackson. Two singers. [INTERVIEWEE] That old man used to play bass... Well him and Johnson and this other fellow that he was talking about, there's three of them used to play together.

ctx.x: And Willie Jackson. Willie Jackson. Nookie Johnson and Willie Jackson. Two singers.

That old man used to play bass, I can't think of his name. Just died recently? Oh no, he'd been dead. He was a bass player. Well him and Johnson and this other fellow that he was talking about, there's three of them used to play together. One played the mandle, one played the guitar and the other played the bass. But there was the one composed that song about Maestress Wagner and Vinny on taking my furniture and gone.
